tasks.label: Board: Build
args: key=$(printf %s "$1" | sed -E 's/[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/_/g'); [ -n "$2" ] && [ "$2" = "$key" ] || { echo "Set crux.boardKey to $key in .vscode/settings.json." >&2; exit 1; }; app=${3%/}; [ -f "$app/CMakeLists.txt" ] || app=$app/zephyr; [ -f "$app/CMakeLists.txt" ] || { echo "No Zephyr application at $3; enter samples/<name>/zephyr." >&2; exit 1; }; exec scripts/build-debug-target.sh "$1" --app "$app"

tasks.label: Board: Flash
args: grep -qsx 1366 /sys/bus/usb/devices/*/idVendor || { echo 'No J-Link probe found. Attach it to WSL2: usbipd attach --wsl --busid <BUSID> (Getting started, section 7).' >&2; exit 1; }; exec west flash -d build/zephyr/${config:crux.boardKey}--current -r jlink

tasks.label: Board: Clean
args: case "$1" in ''|.*|*/*) echo 'Set crux.boardKey in .vscode/settings.json.' >&2; exit 1;; esac; rm -rf -- "build/zephyr/$1" "build/zephyr/$1"--*

tasks.label: native_sim: Build
args: app=${1%/}; [ -f "$app/CMakeLists.txt" ] || app=$app/zephyr; [ -f "$app/CMakeLists.txt" ] || { echo "No Zephyr application at $1; enter samples/<name>/zephyr." >&2; exit 1; }; exec west build -p auto -b native_sim/native/64 -d build/native_sim "$app" -- -DCONFIG_NO_OPTIMIZATIONS=y

tasks.label: native_sim: Run
args: if [ ! -f build/native_sim/CMakeCache.txt ]; then echo 'Run native_sim: Build first.' >&2; exit 1; fi; west build -p never -d build/native_sim || exit; exe=build/native_sim/zephyr/zephyr.exe; if "$exe" -h 2>&1 | grep -q -- -uart_stdinout; then exec "$exe" -uart_stdinout; fi; exec "$exe"

tasks.label: Board: Check probe
args: grep -qsx 1366 /sys/bus/usb/devices/*/idVendor || { echo 'No J-Link probe found. Attach it to WSL2: usbipd attach --wsl --busid <BUSID> (Getting started, section 7).' >&2; exit 1; }

inputs.description: Sample folder, relative to the repository
